Container.Name: BookshelfNG
Container.Overview: Built on .NET 10 LTS, one BookshelfNG instance manages ebook and audiobook libraries, with optional SeerrNG integration.
Container.Description: BookshelfNG is a complete standalone library and acquisition app; SeerrNG is optional. This Snapetech NG fork supplies the book contract used by SeerrNG. The Hardcover image needs a personal Hardcover API token for native metadata. Add it in HARDCOVER_AUTH or in BookshelfNG settings. One instance can manage both ebooks and audiobooks; point both SeerrNG service entries at this instance when using both formats. Do not attach an existing softcover or Readarr database to the Hardcover image without migration.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: bookshelfng bookshelf readarr hardcover ebook audiobook seerrng
Container.Changes: Use the rolling latest tag for the Hardcover image. BookshelfNG runs independently with optional SeerrNG integration.
Container.Requires: Docker and persistent appdata. Configure this app independently before connecting it to SeerrNG.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Web UI Port for the standalone web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent BookshelfNG database, settings, and logs.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Downloads shared with the configured download client.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for files created by this service.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for files created by this service.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone used by this service.

Config.Name: HARDCOVER
